rules.logic: (BIOC(MP-027 Python Writes init py Into the Home Public Folder) OR ABIOC(MP-027 Self-Deleting Python Script Executed From the Home Public Folder) OR BIOC(MP-027 dockerd Launched From a Temp Path by a Python Interpreter) OR BIOC(MP-027 Python Opens Keychain SSH Key and Cloud CLI Credential Files)) AND (ABIOC(MP-027 NGFW Recurring Rare-Domain Communications From a Developer Workstation) OR IOC(91.103.140.191) OR IOC(70.34.245.118)) within 1800s on the same endpoint entity (xdr_data agent_hostname = panw_ngfw_traffic_raw endpoint_device_name, the src_host every leg carries) -> one Slow Pisces developer-compromise incident whose summary names the lure project, the ~/Public RN Loader drop, the credential collection and the C2 destination.
rules.name: Slow Pisces Developer Lure — Endpoint Loader/Stealer and NGFW C2 on One Workstation
